description: This file implements discovery and version management for the custom metrics API in Kubernetes, including fetching server groups, selecting preferred API versions, and caching.

classes.name: apiVersionsFromDiscovery
classes.description: Caches and manages the preferred version of the custom metrics API, including fetching server groups and selecting the appropriate version.

methods.name: fetchVersions
methods.description: Fetches available API groups from the server and retrieves the custom metrics API group.

methods.name: chooseVersion
methods.description: Selects the preferred API version based on available versions and known mappings.

methods.name: PreferredVersion
methods.description: Returns the current preferred version, caching it if necessary.

methods.name: Invalidate
methods.description: Clears the cached preferred version to force re-fetching.
